title: RAIN
metaDescription: 74 Ashoka-cut diamonds · 52.24 ct total — each stone suspended independently in graduated cascade. Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
copy: Seventy-four Ashoka-cut diamonds. Fifty-two point twenty-four carats. Each stone suspended independently from a V-shaped chain, falling at its own length, catching light at its own angle. No two drops land the same way. Rectangular in proportion, architectural in stillness — seventy-four stones in graduated lengths move with the body: a slow, continuous shimmer that follows every turn, every breath, every step.
